### Useful code

If you want to change a certain part of the code using the following code in Unix:

```{r eval = FALSE, class.source = 'fold-show'}
#Rmd script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/r_files
sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.Rmd

#R script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/r_files/functions
sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.R
```

If you want to share a dataset and get a reproducible object, use the following R code:

```{r eval = FALSE, class.source = 'fold-show'}
dput()
```
